name: Thrust Octane Booster

features.text: Raises the octane rating of your fuel up to 3 / 30*
Helps prevent rough idling, hesitation and stalling.
Suitable for all fuel types including ethanol up to E85.
Safe for turbos, oxygen sensors and catalytic converters**

description: A concentrated, dual-purpose fuel treatment that contains powerful octane boosting additives that reduce knocking and pinging while improving engine performance, throttle response and horsepower. Thrust Octane Booster features top-tier detergents that clean fuel injectors, intake valves, and combustion chambers, making it especially effective on high-performance and turbocharged engines. Compatible with all gasoline fuel types including ethanol blends up to E85. *Depending on the quality of fuel, Thrust Octane Booster can increase octane levels up to 3 numbers or 30 points. **When used as directed Thrust Octane Booster is safe for types of fuel systems.
application: Direction: 1) Add entire contents of the bottle to the fuel tank at each fill-up for maximum performance. One bottle treats up to 18 gallons of gasoline.
